scope: Independent focused macOS GUI bootstrap feasibility peer, not a second question inventory or complete flow
status: Future implementation prerequisites only; no native macOS feasibility acceptance
conclusion: A GUI-only online install needs a controller/UI available before the target Python/PySide runtime and able to remain alive after Installer.app finishes. Current native launcher has no such UI; its missing-runtime branch opens Terminal. Existing Qt cannot be the only host for clean first-user or damaged-runtime installation.

source_proven_obstacles.fact: Native package installs application/support payload and command symlink, but no per-user Qt runtime before package completion. Launcher checks only executable per-user Python; it does not compare requested app/runtime version.
First-user helper opens from Terminal, runs per-user setup, then requests open-a. An existing lock directory prints already-running and exits0; this is not runtime validation or GUI relaunch proof.

Bootstrap downloads private Python before target dependencies exist; PySide6 import check happens only after target package installation. Collected privacy/account choices currently require TTY or explicit flags, or later Qt profile onboarding.

Bootstrap cleanup runs before new dependency validation and installer-made roots may be removed. Protected user-data locations and individual kept paths are narrower than preservation of all caches/files under an installer root. The recognized in-app online update uses an independent same-environment upgrade path; do not confuse it with first-user bootstrap.

ownership_boundaries.owner: Independent native GUI setup/controller, architecture chosen by Home
ownership_boundaries.must_own: Display and retain product choices that affect prerequisites/downloaded wheel line, installer language, install scope/root and reviewed folder contents. Capture explicit answers and original user identity; keep privacy/account questions separate. If privacy is deferred, record uncollected rather than inferred off/yes. Never assume target Qt exists.
ownership_boundaries.not_proven: No native host, signed wrapper distribution, resource-localization bridge or structured bootstrap control protocol exists in the inspected current route.

ownership_boundaries.owner: Installer.app and OS authorization UI for scoped protected changes; product controller remains distinct
ownership_boundaries.must_own: OS alone requests administrator authorization. Keep product review/choices outside authorization; refusal cancels only the scoped operation. Do not request or store administrator passwords, run product preferences as an elevated user, or interpret successful authorization as privacy/backend/account consent.
ownership_boundaries.not_proven: Exact OS prompts/focus, current macOS authorization behavior and package completion correlation were not observed.

ownership_boundaries.owner: Persistent GUI controller plus bounded noninteractive worker
ownership_boundaries.must_own: Keep progress, cancellation, recovery/retry and errors visible while Qt is unavailable. Supply only reviewed bounded arguments/choice receipt; no Terminal or interactive stdin/sudo fallback. Distinguish lock contention, helper error, payload completion, verified runtime and app-ready handshake. Controller and rollback evidence must survive replacement/removal of the target tree.
ownership_boundaries.not_proven: Current shell helper has no typed controller protocol or dependable GUI-ready receipt; exit0 cannot replace these.

ownership_boundaries.owner: Installed app/profile/preferences and optional provider-owned authentication
ownership_boundaries.must_own: Qt may apply explicitly collected consent or ask when uncollected via a valid profile. Current already-applied QSettings gate preserves prior choices, so reinstall must not silently reapply a new profile. Preserve account guidance/login/tool permission distinctions. Installer backend request and observed runtime backend are different facts.
ownership_boundaries.not_proven: Current account setup dialog provides copy-to-Terminal guidance, not fully graphical authentication; completing installation or ticking setup does not mean logged-in or authorized tools.

concrete_implementation_prerequisites: Ship a GUI host independent of target venv, old app availability and any tree cleanup/replacement owns; bind supported architecture/macOS range and signed distribution strategy. A separately bundled toolkit is an explicit packaging choice, not existing target PySide availability.

Replace missing-runtime Terminal handoff with a noninteractive worker plus versioned, correlated progress/result/choice channel; include original user/root, intended bundle/runtime identity and cancellation state. Validate all boundary inputs without command interpolation or credential capture.

Define a durable user-scoped choices/profile bridge before runtime creation. Current schema1 records backend facts and consent but no language or install-job/GUI identity. Do not overload collected=true, log text or OS approval as a new receipt.

Keep Installer payload result separate from worker result and actual app-ready/version/path proof. Requested native open or an executable Python alone is insufficient. Lock contention requires attach/wait/refuse semantics, never install success.

Bind an ownership-aware preserve/optional-cleanup allowlist and reviewed folder contents. Exclude shared caches, custom weights/data and unrelated user folders; an existing broad purge command is not ordinary GUI cleanup. Retain rollback state through validated runtime switch and relaunch.

Retain error/cancel UI independently through denied authorization, missing network/disk space, damaged runtime and relaunch failure; define safely recoverable transaction boundaries rather than promising cancellation reverses completed changes.
unresolved_Home_choices: Independent native setup wrapper versus another explicitly supported Apple-native GUI integration; where product pages live before/during/after Installer.app.
Whether privacy choices are collected natively or deferred to Qt, and the explicit language/profile/receipt version bridge while preserving existing preferences.
Exact supported per-user roots and launcher mapping; current C launcher hardcodes HOME/Library root while helper permits an override.
Backend choice labels/allowed macOS options and later execution policy; requested cpu is not proof runtime MPS will never be selected.
Cache/temp ownership allowlist, folder-content presentation and deletion timing; current source cannot justify unconditional cache preservation.
Runtime recovery/rollback horizon and exact relaunch identity handshake, plus treatment of another already-running installer.

Scope of GUI-only account setup: skip/defer optional account onboarding or implement a separately reviewed graphical provider flow. Current copy-to-Terminal dialog does not satisfy graphical authentication.
primary_docs_qualification: The frozen source establishes the dependency and lifecycle obstacles. Native host/OS integration is a proposal; this note makes no Apple/Qt API, entitlement, signing or native-dialog guarantee requiring additional documentation.
coordination: Source findings and prerequisites sent directly to contracts_701; full chosen flow/English and final semantic peer remain its/root-owned artifacts.
limitations: No macOS execution, Installer.app, native GUI, provider/auth, model or test session.
No package/env/system/NAS changes or source edits.
Source/catalog/tutorial capture and release holds persist.
